document_title: Multi-Modal Synchronization Semantic Audit & Hierarchy Reconciliation
abstract: Definitively resolves the semantic inversion in prior drafts where Secondary Sensor had nominal allocation of 8.0 ms but hard acceptance limit of 5.0 ms. Establishes a strictly monotonic parameter hierarchy: nominal_target <= acceptance_limit <= hard_rejection_limit across all multi-modal channels.

budget_identity_preservation.identity_formula: 18.00 ms + 15.33 ms == 33.33 ms (nominal 30.0 fps video frame period)
budget_identity_preservation.epistemic_classification: DESIGN_BUDGET_IDENTITY (Not empirical physical proof of hardware performance)

camera_subsystem.channel: Optical Video Capture (Cameras A, B, C, D Strobe Sync)
camera_subsystem.physical_quantity: Optical sensor exposure hardware trigger jitter relative to PTP 1PPS pulse
camera_subsystem.semantic_definition: Camera shutter exposure triggers within 2.0 ms of PTP reference; excursions up to 5.0 ms consume reserve; > 5.0 ms fails Gate C1/C2.

can_gateway_subsystem.channel: Vehicle Telemetry Gateway (CAN Bus to PTP/UDP Ethernet)
can_gateway_subsystem.physical_quantity: Transit buffer latency from CAN frame EOF to UDP egress packet timestamp
can_gateway_subsystem.semantic_definition: CAN transceiver FIFO queue delivers telemetry within 5.0 ms; excursions up to 10.0 ms consume reserve; > 10.0 ms fails Gate C1/C3.

secondary_sensor_subsystem.channel: Secondary Zone LiDAR / Radar Node (Ethernet PTP/TSN Stream)
secondary_sensor_subsystem.physical_quantity: Network packet transit and pointcloud UDP aggregation latency across TSN switch fabric
secondary_sensor_subsystem.semantic_definition: RECONCILED: Prior draft had nominal=8ms but hard limit=5ms (inversion). Reconciled so nominal physical network hop target is 5.0 ms, acceptance limit is 8.0 ms (matching the 8.0 ms nominal budget allocation), and hard rejection occurs at > 8.0 ms (or > 10.0 ms in degraded mode).

operating_system_process_jitter.channel: Host Linux Kernel & User-Space DAQ Scheduling Queue
operating_system_process_jitter.physical_quantity: Kernel network stack buffering, socket context switch, and thread wakeup jitter
operating_system_process_jitter.semantic_definition: Process thread wakeup and socket read latency within 1.0 ms nominal, budgeted up to 3.0 ms; > 5.0 ms indicates system CPU overload.

composite_multi_modal_envelope.measurement_method: Multi-modal optical strobe and physical impactor captured simultaneously by cameras and vehicle accelerometer
composite_multi_modal_envelope.reconciliation_rule: The composite skew is an independently measured empirical value. It CANNOT be inferred simply by summing component allocations. If any component exceeds its hard_rejection_limit, Gate C1 FAILS regardless of composite total.
